# awscc_licensemanager_report_generator (Resource)

A report generator that creates periodic reports about your AWS License Manager license configurations.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `report_context` (Attributes) Details of the license configurations and asset groups that this generator reports on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--report_context))
- `report_frequency` (Attributes) Details about how frequently reports are generated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--report_frequency))
- `report_generator_name` (String) Name of the report generator.
- `report_type` (List of String) Type of reports to generate. The report type determines the data reported on.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the report generator.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) An array of key-value pairs to apply to this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the report generator.
- `create_time` (String) Time the report was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `report_creator_account` (String) The AWS account ID used to create the report generator.
- `s3_location` (Attributes) Details of the S3 bucket that report generator reports are published to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--s3_location))

<a id="nestedatt--report_context"></a>
### Nested Schema for `report_context`

Optional:

- `license_asset_group_arns` (List of String) Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) of the license asset groups to include in the report.
- `license_configuration_arns` (List of String) Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) of the license configurations that this generator reports on.
- `report_end_date` (String) End date for the report data collection period.
- `report_start_date` (String) Start date for the report data collection period.


<a id="nestedatt--report_frequency"></a>
### Nested Schema for `report_frequency`

Optional:

- `period` (String) Time period between each report. The period can be daily, weekly, or monthly.
- `value` (Number) Number of times within the frequency period that a report is generated. The only supported value is 1.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The tag key.
- `value` (String) The tag value.


<a id="nestedatt--s3_location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `s3_location`

Read-Only:

- `bucket` (String) Name of the S3 bucket reports are published to.
- `key_prefix` (String) Prefix of the S3 bucket reports are published to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_licensemanager_report_generator.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the report generator

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_licensemanager_report_generator.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_licensemanager_report_generator.example "arn"
```
